slides.title: Welcome to Misinformation and Deepfakes
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Misinformation and Deepfakes.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to understand how **AI** creates fake content.
Next, you will learn to identify risks of deepfake media.
Then, you will learn to verify digital sources.
Finally, you will apply media literacy skills.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
You will need a device with internet access.
A web browser is also required.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
Basic understanding of **AI** concepts is helpful.
Familiarity with digital media is also useful.

slides.title: What are Deepfakes?
slides.narration:
What exactly are **deepfakes**?
They are synthetic media.
**AI** generates them to look real.
They can be audio, video, or images.

slides.title: How AI Creates Fakes
slides.narration:
How does **AI** make these?
It uses special **ML** models.
These models learn from real data.
Then they create new, fake content.

slides.title: Risks of Deepfake Media
slides.narration:
What are the dangers?
**Deepfakes** can spread false news.
They can harm reputations.
They can even influence elections.
This poses a serious threat.
slides.image_prompt: People looking at fake news on screens

slides.title: Real-World Examples
slides.narration:
Consider a fake speech.
An **AI** can mimic a voice perfectly.
It can also swap faces in videos.
This makes fake events seem real.
Remember the recent fake news reports.
slides.image_prompt: Fake video of a public figure speaking

slides.title: Verifying Digital Sources
slides.narration:
How can we check content?
Always question the source.
Look for inconsistencies in media.
Check for strange movements or audio.
Use reliable fact-checking websites.
slides.image_prompt: Magnifying glass over a digital screen

slides.title: Building Media Literacy
slides.narration:
What is media literacy?
It is the ability to analyze media.
You learn to spot manipulation.
This skill protects you online.
Practice critical thinking always.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
We explored **deepfakes** and **AI**.
We saw how **AI** creates fake content.
The risks of misinformation are high.
Verifying sources is very important.
Media literacy helps us stay safe.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Find a news article online.
Check its source carefully.
Identify three signs of credibility.
Share your findings with a friend.
